name: InlineCheckbox

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Deprecated, please use `aria-label` instead. Specify the label for the control

props.name: checked
props.description: Specify whether the underlying control is checked, or not

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the underlying input control should be disabled

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Specify whether the control is in an indeterminate state

props.name: name
props.description: Provide a `name` for the underlying input control

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon InlineCheckbox rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
